gen-fs-expose-gf-open-sans: Expose packs its capitals and lowercase into a tight, compressed stride with almost no pause between them. And Open Sans handles the opposite job, smooth curves and bulky lowercase that never clog.
gen-fs-expose-gf-orienta: Orienta has counters that breathe like a hollow reed cut open, with lowercase close in height to its capitals, under Expose. Compression meets openness.
gen-fs-expose-gf-oxygen: Expose sets striking, refined letters with barely any gap between x-height and caps, all in a compressed cadence. Oxygen's open curves offer the release.
gen-fs-expose-gf-parkinsans: Striking from the first glance, Expose keeps its lowercase low against its caps and its pace tight. Parkinsans takes over below with one stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters that stay crisp when shrunk.
gen-fs-expose-gf-pathway-extreme: Expose is a refined display face with a compressed rhythm. It excels at tight, striking impact, while Pathway Extreme, a plain sans, handles the quieter work with open rounded letters and a big x-height.
gen-fs-expose-gf-prompt: Hardly any gap separates Expose's lowercase from its capitals. Prompt, a plain sans, gives long reading an oversized small-letter look and open apertures that keep each line easy to follow.
gen-fs-expose-gf-pt-sans-caption: Expose compresses its striking, refined letters until there is very little pause between them. PT Sans Caption's unclosed bowls and big-bodied lowercase would make a long passage feel inviting.
gen-fs-expose-gf-puritan: Compressed spacing and a minimal gap between x-height and caps give Expose its striking, refined look. Puritan, a plain sans, simply offers rounded forms and oversized e and a counters.
gen-fs-expose-gf-questrial: Expose squeezes its x-height almost up to the capitals, leaving hardly any pause between letters. Questrial then reads with open, flat sans-serif strokes of one width, a tall band of lowercase moving smoothly down a long passage.
gen-fs-expose-gf-radio-canada: Expose compresses its refined letters with barely any gap between x-height and caps, a striking, tightly packed rhythm. Radio Canada's single stroke width is the pair's strongest quality.
